mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ179. The user pulls back a fist and slams it down; holding the input charges the strike while absorbing melee attacks. At full charge, the attack becomes stronger and can break the guard of attackers during the charge, enabling a follow-up Ultimate. Exact charge timing and numerical damage remain unresolved.
